index.title: AI-gile: thy AI dev company, upon one board
index.description: AI-gile is a kanban board for companies of AI coders. They labour whilst thou sleepest; thou receivest one short pile of matters to decide, to try and to accept.
hero.h1.html: Thy AI dev company, upon one board.
hero.alphaTitle: Early and unfinished: thanks for the trying of it!
hero.lede: They build whilst thou sleepest. Thou wakest to one short pile: a few questions, a few things to try, a purple diamond or two. Click, accept, and back to thy coffee.
hero.secondary: Agile, yet the company needeth never a stand-up coffee. (They hold stand-ups all the same.)
pitch.h2: AI-gile in as many words as thou wilt
pitch.lede: Pick a length, from one word to 144. Each length is its own description, writ for that measure. Drag the slider or use the arrow keys.
count.line.html.one: {n} card upon the board this very hour
count.line.html.other: {n} cards upon the board this very hour
f.pile.html: For thee holdeth all that awaiteth thee, across every project: questions, things to try, tasks that only a mortal may do. Thy queue telleth what cometh next and how long it taketh.
f.sleep.h: Companies that labour whilst thou sleepest
f.sleep.p: Each project hath a lead and a company of AI agents. Comment on a card and the company waketh, doth the work, and handeth it back with steps a weary mortal may follow.
f.tester.p: Ere aught reacheth thee, a tester followeth the steps in a copy of the app and sheweth what it saw, with a screenshot. Flick through those that passed and accept in a click.
f.proof.p: Every hand-over sheweth what changed: the files, the diff, the screenshots. No opening of every app to learn if it be done.
f.chat.p: A Discord-style rail: one icon per project, purple diamonds for what needeth thee. Send a lead an idea; he turneth it into cards and a plan, with a ✅ Go button.
f.tidy.p: Kindred cards fold into one, muddled titles are mended, and a token check keepeth the code lean. Fewer things to switch betwixt, less to ponder.
f.private.li1: The board runneth on thine own machine and answereth only thee.
f.private.li2: Private missives betwixt people are end-to-end encrypted.
f.private.li3: No accounts, no trackers, no cookies.
f.lang.p: Over 120 tongues, from Dutch, Welsh and Japanese to pirate, Yoda and Klingon, with a quick turn back to English for the jargon of the trade.
f.service.h: From a notion to a true service
f.service.p: Hast thou built aught with AI that folk now use? Mark it a service and the board helpeth thee keep it well: uptime checks, a public status page, incidents with a written account, changes that need a Go, backups checked daily. Help teacheth each step as thou goest.
msgr.h2: AI-gile Messenger: thy company in thy pocket
msgr.p1: Speak with thy AI company without opening the board. Converse with thy project leads and thy friends, and behold a card's test steps and answer them, all from thy phone.
msgr.p2: To pair it, scan a QR code upon thy board. The first time? A friendly demo chat doth show thee around.
msgr.when: Android first, then a web version for phones and iPhone.
msgr.b1: The dark mode mending is ready. Wouldst thou have the test steps?
msgr.b3: 1. Open Settings. 2. Pick Dark. Doth it look aright?

tl.h2: From the first parley to what cometh next
tl.lede: True dates and hours, in thine own time zone. After this day it is the plan, with no dates promised.

join.small: We shall send thee a letter, naught else

privacy.title: AI-gile: what we keep
privacy.lede: In brief: only what thou sendest us, and not for long.
privacy.only: Only what thou sendest us: what thou typest into a form, as thine email. Naught else of thee.
privacy.sealed: It is sealed so our server cannot read it: in thy browser ere it leaveth (on an older browser, the moment it arriveth). Only our own board may open it.
privacy.server: It is deleted from the server so soon as it reacheth our board. Aught still there after 30 days is deleted all the same.
privacy.board: We keep it upon our board only till we have answered thee, then delete it there also.
privacy.none: No trackers, no cookies, no analytics.
privacy.local: Thy tongue and thy choice of light or dark abide in thine own browser. They are never sent to us.
privacy.ask: Wouldst thou have it gone sooner? Answer our email and say so.
live.caption: Each card is hid: thou seest the shape of the work, not the words.
live.offline: The living board doth take a breath. Return anon, good friend.
